other_text: HE'S OCEANS AWAY FROM HOME. HE'S BEEN ABDUCTED AND CONFINED. HE HAS A TASK HE DOESN'T UNDERSTAND. IN A LANGUAGE HE DOESN'T KNOW. IF HE DOESN'T GET TO WORK, HE DIES.
